core_obligations: Get one equivalence from separability of the field extension and one implication from the definition of smoothness (proof lines 39052-39054).

Assume the differentials are free at the prime and prove regularity by an induction: choose a nonzerodivisor, divide out, and apply the induction hypothesis together with the criterion for regularity along a nonzerodivisor (proof lines 39055-39083).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the separable and definitional implications (proof lines 39051-39054).
Prove regularity by induction from freeness of the differentials (proof lines 39055-39084).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in characteristic zero smoothness at a prime, freeness of the module of differentials at that prime, and regularity of the local ring are equivalent for a finite type algebra over a field (statement lines 39037-39049). The proof does not reprove the general theory: it uses separability in characteristic zero for one equivalence, the definition for one implication, and then proves regularity from freeness of the differentials by an induction that divides out a nonzerodivisor and applies the regularity criterion (proof lines 39051-39084). Choosing the nonzerodivisor so that the induction descends is the step that carries the last implication. H2.
